input.contract_yaml:
# Member eligibility from a (synthetic) payer: one row per member, one file per day.
# Generated from the Synthea patients by packs/healthcare/generators/eligibility.py.
feed: healthcare.eligibility
version: 2
owner: vendor-ops@example.com
description: >
  Daily full eligibility file: every enrolled member with their plan and coverage dates.
  All data is synthetic.
classification: restricted
source:
  channels: [minio, sftp, api]
  filename_pattern: "elig_*.csv"
  # The business date in the name (elig_YYYYMMDD.csv). It must be a real date, not after
  # the day the file was received, and at most 7 days before it; otherwise the file is
  # quarantined (FILE.NAME_DATE). A name with no digits takes the date it was received.
  filename_date:
    regex: "^elig_([0-9]+)"
    format: "%Y%m%d"
    max_days_before_received: 7
    max_days_after_received: 0
format: { type: csv, delimiter: ",", encoding: utf-8, header: true }
expected_arrival: { cron: "0 6 * * *", grace: 2h }
on_row_violation: quarantine_row
max_bad_row_ratio: 0.05          # above this, the whole file is rejected
min_rows: 1
columns:
  - { name: member_id, type: string, required: true, unique: true, pattern: "^M[0-9]{9}$" }
  - { name: first_name, type: string, required: true, phi: true }
  - { name: last_name, type: string, required: true, phi: true }
  - { name: dob, type: date, required: true, min: "1900-01-01", max: today, phi: true }
  - { name: sex, type: string, required: true, allowed: [F, M, U] }
  - { name: plan_code, type: string, required: true, allowed: [HMO, PPO, EPO, HDHP] }
  - { name: coverage_start, type: date, required: true, min: "1990-01-01" }
  - { name: coverage_end, type: date, description: "Empty while coverage is open" }
  - name: patient_ref
    type: string
    description: The payer's link to the clinical record (here the Synthea patient id)
    phi: true
  - name: member_phone
    type: string
    description: Member phone number, added in file version 2 (shape 999-9999 in the sample)
    phi: true
